title: OutputProvenanceResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/provenance (HEL-1206). One read joining output -> node -> pipeline -> source(s) with the last non-dry run and assertion counts. `lastRun` is null when the pipeline never ran a non-dry run; `completedAt`/`rowCount` are explicit nulls when unknown (`rowCount` is the exact row count of the Output's OWN node snapshot, null when that snapshot is empty/absent). Never contains `errorLog` or assertion `observed` values. An Output the caller cannot read is 404.

sources.description: Every data source feeding the Output: trunk roots by root position, then direct join/union/lookup Source secondaries in discovery order. A source that no longer resolves is omitted.

nodePath.description: Step kinds from the trunk root to the Output's node along the primary parent chain; empty for a root-bound Output.
